normalisation_forensics.extends: capacity_check.py, whose scope note explicitly excludes 'entangling the referent register with itself'. This module supplies exactly that case and the cross-referent case, and its selftest reproduces capacity_check's committed anchors through the generalised path.

provenance.recompute_mode: RECOMPUTED (bounds, witnesses and size-matched nulls all re-derived here through the committed instrument's own machinery and asserted against the committed diagnostic)

category.source: instrument_sb_bounds.CATEGORIES -- doc 54 SS5.2, user-confirmed; imported, never re-typed

A0-W.definition: A0-W: exp68/exp69's F2 product register on the OLD map theta = (p + 1) pi. The anchor family; its bound of record is the committed F2 value, reproduced here through the extended path.
A0-W.bound_of_record_source: committed F2 (diagnostic_sb_bounds.json, reproduced through the extended path)

recomputed_here.method: CONSTRUCTIVE LOWER BOUND (48 restarts x 500 steps + 6 LS-drop starts) -- NOT a maximum

A0-W.note: A0-W is the anchor family: exp68/exp69's committed F2 map and its committed 1.0000 (160/160), reproduced through the extended path. Its map identity with exp69's F2 is asserted, not assumed.

EA-ctrl.definition: EA-ctrl: the same frozen-angle single-qubit map WITHOUT the CZ (runtime space), run in exp70's codepath. Dual role: codepath control (must reproduce exp69's R-A arms) and the map-matched contrast baseline for N-across.

recomputed_here.method: CONSTRUCTIVE LOWER BOUND (48 restarts x 500 steps + 6 LS-drop starts) -- NOT a maximum

EA-ctrl.note: the recomputed value is the instrument's TWO-stage search. For N-across / EA-ctrl the bound OF RECORD is the committed 0.9625 three-stage value (doc 54 SS17.7's supersession) and the 0.9250 here is a CONSISTENCY CHECK, never a second bound; the null and percentile are stated at the METHOD-MATCHED 0.9250 because no three-stage null exists (doc 56 SS10 note 1, doc 47 SS16.1).

P-eps.definition: P-eps: product register on the eps-map. theta_k = p_k (pi - 2 eps)/2 + pi/2, eps = pi/6; RY(theta_1) on q0, RY(theta_2) on q1, NO entangler. d_ref = 9, d_joint = 81. The MAP-MATCHED PRODUCT TWIN.
P-eps.bound_of_record_source: computed by instrument_entangled_bounds.py (constructive lower bound, no prior exists)

recomputed_here.method: CONSTRUCTIVE LOWER BOUND (48 restarts x 500 steps + 6 LS-drop starts) -- NOT a maximum

P-eps.note: no committed prior bound exists for this map; the recomputed value IS the bound of record, a constructive lower bound.

N-in.definition: N-in: E-in on the eps-map. RY(theta_1) on q0 then CRY(theta_2) q0 -> q1, orientation PC1-controls-PC2 registered a priori. d_ref = 6 (outer square of the three state coefficients), d_joint = 36.
N-in.bound_of_record_source: computed by instrument_entangled_bounds.py (constructive lower bound, no prior exists)

recomputed_here.method: CONSTRUCTIVE LOWER BOUND (48 restarts x 500 steps + 6 LS-drop starts) -- NOT a maximum

N-in.note: no committed prior bound exists for this map; the recomputed value IS the bound of record, a constructive lower bound.

N-across.definition: N-across: one qubit per referent on the FROZEN angle map (runtime space), plus one CZ between the two referents' wires after intro. JOINT feature: the 10 independent entries of the outer square of the 4-dim amplitude vector.

recomputed_here.method: CONSTRUCTIVE LOWER BOUND (48 restarts x 500 steps + 6 LS-drop starts) -- NOT a maximum

N-across.note: the recomputed value is the instrument's TWO-stage search. For N-across / EA-ctrl the bound OF RECORD is the committed 0.9625 three-stage value (doc 54 SS17.7's supersession) and the 0.9250 here is a CONSISTENCY CHECK, never a second bound; the null and percentile are stated at the METHOD-MATCHED 0.9250 because no three-stage null exists (doc 56 SS10 note 1, doc 47 SS16.1).

grade2_point_predictions.extrapolation_under_test_TWO_PRECEDENT: doc 56 SS9.2. The median comes from n = 13 rows in ONE task family (the single-RY K = 1 / width population). doc 55 SS20.4 recorded grade 2 holding for five of six exp69 arms and being REFUTED for R2-W -- the T = 2 PRODUCT-REGISTER arm, the same family P-eps-T2 and N-in-T2 belong to. A grade-2 miss on the four-wire T = 2 arms is therefore EXPECTED, is registered here as expected, and refutes the ONE-FAMILY EXTRAPOLATION rather than the bound.

grade3_under_conversion_flag.flag: under-conversion predicted for a BELOW-NULL category (the F1 observation, made prospective -- doc 55 SS19.2 grade 3)
grade3_under_conversion_flag.method_note: doc 56 SS9.3 / SS10 note 1: the N-across and EA-ctrl percentiles are computed at the METHOD-MATCHED two-stage value 0.9250 against a two-stage null, because no three-stage null exists. The verdict is robust to the choice -- 0.9625 > 0.9250 > 0.7940 -- so the category is above its null under either reading.
grade3_under_conversion_flag.verdict: UNTESTABLE THIS RUN -- no exp70 arm has a below-null category (P-eps 92.5th percentile, N-in 98.0th, N-across 92.0th, EA-ctrl 92.5th). Recorded rather than quietly dropped, exactly as doc 55 SS19.2 recorded it for exp69.
grade3_under_conversion_flag.structural_observation_DESCRIPTIVE: doc 56 SS9.3: N-in and P-eps both reach 1.0000 but their NULLS differ -- N-in's size-matched null mean is 0.8991 +/- 0.0572 against P-eps's 0.9429 +/- 0.0403, putting the real category at the 98.0th percentile for N-in and the 92.5th for P-eps. The 36-dimensional E-in space interpolates random labellings LESS than the 81-dimensional product space while still reaching the real category's ceiling. Reported because two identical 1.0000s are NOT identical instruments. It licenses nothing (doc 52 SS2.2).

degenerate_entanglement_gate_doc56_SS7_3.rule: EVERY N-in item's referents must have concurrence >= 0.10 under the eps-map, computed from |sin t1| |sin(t2/2)| on the item's own two nouns, asserted PER ITEM at smoke
degenerate_entanglement_gate_doc56_SS7_3.why_it_is_asserted_anyway: doc 56 SS3's whole lesson is that 'the map should be fine' is not a gate. Under exp68's registered map four of the 24 nouns -- two exactly at zero -- would carry a PRODUCT state through an arm named entangled.
degenerate_entanglement_gate_doc56_SS7_3.NOT_applied_to_N_across: doc 56 SS7.3, registered honestly: 4 of the 80 E-across casts fall below concurrence 0.10 and are NOT excluded. Dropping casts from a frozen dataset to make an arm look entangled is the opposite of a validity gate. The weak-pair fraction is REPORTED and doc 56 SS6.8's per-item stratification exists so it can be read post-hoc without a rerun.

e_across_over_the_80_SB_casts.closed_form: purity = 1 - (sin tA sin tB)^2 / 2, both wires
e_across_over_the_80_SB_casts.honest_note: many pairs are NEAR-PRODUCT. Over the full 24-noun inventory the committed diagnostic reports per-pair purity 0.5764-0.9999 with median 0.983, i.e. the median cast is only weakly entangled. E-across is a MECHANISM PROBE and this is the honest measure of how much mechanism it actually injects.

entanglement_distribution_doc56_SS3_SS4_.honest_note_doc56_SS4_4: MANY PAIRS ARE NEAR-PRODUCT. The median E-across cast sits at purity 0.9192, i.e. weakly entangled. E-across injects real but MODEST mechanism, and the size of any measured effect must be read against that, not against the maximum the gate could produce.

A0-W.phi_definition: the outer product of per-referent vectors, agent-first (d_ref = 9, d_joint = 81)

map_identity.exp69_F2_definition: F2: two-qubit register, theta0 = SCALE(PC1) on qubit 0, theta1 = SCALE(PC2) on qubit 1, both by theta = (p + 1) * pi        -> [0, 2pi); u = vec(u(theta0) (x) u(theta1)). d = 9.

exp69_R-W_crosscheck.note: A0-W's map IS exp69's F2 map (asserted element-by-element above), so exp69's committed R-W witness is a legitimate second witness for the SAME reachable class. MAX-FS witnesses are not unique, so the two need not agree pointwise; the rank agreement is reported rather than asserted. exp70's witness of record for A0-W is the one recomputed HERE, at doc 56's registered budget.

EA-ctrl.phi_definition: the genuinely JOINT 10-coordinate vector (outer square of the 4-dim real amplitude vector), agent-first. It has NO per-referent factorisation, which is exactly why doc 56 SS15.3 REPLACES rather than reuses exp69's 'agent-first outer product' phrasing for this family.

P-eps.phi_definition: the outer product of per-referent vectors, agent-first (d_ref = 9, d_joint = 81)

N-in.phi_definition: the outer product of per-referent vectors, agent-first (d_ref = 6, d_joint = 36)

N-across.phi_definition: the genuinely JOINT 10-coordinate vector (outer square of the 4-dim real amplitude vector), agent-first. It has NO per-referent factorisation, which is exactly why doc 56 SS15.3 REPLACES rather than reuses exp69's 'agent-first outer product' phrasing for this family.

witness_convention_doc56_SS15_3: the MAX-FS witness is NOT unique, so the registered convention is the committed search's output at its registered seed (0, capacity_check.DEFAULT_BUDGET verbatim), exported at bound-computation time. THE RE-PINNING THAT MATTERS: Phi is the MAP'S OWN joint feature, not a universal one. For P-eps and N-in it is the outer product of per-referent vectors (81- and 36-dim); for N-across and EA-ctrl it is the genuinely joint 10-coordinate vector, which has no per-referent factorisation, so exp69's 'agent-first outer product' phrasing does not transfer and is REPLACED rather than reused. margin(twin) = <W, Phi>/(||W|| ||Phi||) with the sign convention of `maxfs_lower`; pair margin = min over the pair's two twins.
witness_caveat_doc56_SS15_3: ALL FOUR exp70 witnesses come from LOWER-BOUND searches -- no exact d = 3 pair witness is used anywhere -- so every margin is noisier BY CONSTRUCTION than exp69's d = 3 arms' were. The attenuation doc 55 SS20.4 saw only on the W arms should be expected ACROSS THE BOARD.
registered_analysis_doc56_SS15_3: Spearman rank correlation between witness margin and per-item held-out accuracy, per arm. DESCRIPTIVE, positive expected, NO criterion reads it.
bounds_are_context_only: doc 56 SS6's opening sentence and SS10: NO criterion in doc 56 SS6 is read against any number in this file. doc 54 SS17.7 is the standing reason -- a bound moved by 0.0375 AFTER exp68 reported and no stored boolean moved with it. These predictions are a PROSPECTIVE TEST OF THE INSTRUMENT, graded, and they arm doc 56 SS6.6's bug-hunt row (any arm exceeding its bound by > 0.06). They may not be promoted onto a criterion.

clifford_result_doc56_SS4_5.statement: CZ is Clifford, so conjugating a general readout by it PERMUTES the Pauli coordinates and leaves the reachable function space invariant. N-across's grade-1 bound EQUALS EA-ctrl's BY PROOF, Fourier closure is a NULL INSTRUMENT for N-across (doc 56 SS7.2 replaces it), and the joint-state comparator cannot separate the two either -- so any measured N-across vs EA-ctrl difference is TRAINABILITY or INDUCTIVE BIAS, never capacity.

E_in.per_referent_feature: (a^2, b^2, c^2, ab, ac, bc) -- outer square of the three coefficients
E_in.relation_to_the_product_register: NEITHER NESTED. The two half-angle terms leave the product span; `sin t1` alone is absent from the E-in span. The intersection is 4-dimensional (ranks 6, 9, 11 for E-in, P-eps and their union). The map is RESTRUCTURED, not enlarged, and nothing about which reaches further follows from dimension counting.
E_in.completeness: COMPLETE. The six coordinates are derived in closed form and the claimed 6-function basis is certified to span exactly the same space.

E_across.state: ( cA cB, cA sB, sA cB, -sA sB ), cX = cos(tX/2), sX = sin(tX/2)
E_across.joint_feature: the 10 independent entries of the outer square of that 4-vector
E_across.clifford_argument: CZ is Clifford, so conjugation permutes the Pauli coordinates; with a general readout the reachable function space is INVARIANT. The E-across span is exactly the 9-dimensional product span, identical to EA-ctrl's, with <X(x)X> identically zero and <Y(x)Y> = sin tA sin tB carrying what <X(x)X> carried in the control.
consequences: the N-across grade-1 bound EQUALS EA-ctrl's, by proof

FOURIER CLOSURE IS A NULL INSTRUMENT for N-across: closure in the product basis holds with the CZ present and absent alike, so validity must be asserted by the purity closed form and a circuit-difference check instead
the joint-state comparator for N-across is the SAME function class as EA-ctrl's, so it cannot separate them either: any measured difference is trainability / inductive bias, never capacity
E_across.completeness: COMPLETE, and verified: the Pauli closed-form table is checked against the statevector to better than 1e-12 on a 441-point grid.

Every arm runs on exp69's frozen Part A dataset (stories_exp69_QA.json, sha asserted at smoke) with the T = 1 and T = 2 item forms exp69 already generated and V-suite-cleared. exp70_datagen.py DOES NOT EXIST AND MAY NOT BE WRITTEN (doc 56 SS5.1 / SS16.1).
